title: Team Lock
description: A secure team management plugin with friendly-fire toggles. Perfectly designed to stop bounty-farming exploits!
body:
# 👥 Team Lock

A robust and lightweight team management plugin built to give server administrators and players total control over crew alliances and combat safety. 

---

## ✨ Key Features

* **🔒 Secure Alliances:** Create, join, and lock teams easily with intuitive commands.
* **🛡️ Anti-Friendly Fire:** Completely disable damage between team members to ensure true coordination during chaotic battles.
* **⚔️ Exploit Prevention:** Explicitly built to block players from cheesing combat systems or cycling money.

---

## 🌌 Ultimate Synergy with Bounty Rift

Team Lock was custom-developed by us to be the ultimate companion for **Bounty Rift**! 

By forcing players into locked teams and disabling friendly fire, it completely shuts down the "friendship exploit" where players take turns killing their friends to farm escalating login bounties. If you are running Bounty Rift, this plugin is a must-have to keep your server economy fair and competitive.

---

## 📌 Compatibility

* **Supported Versions:** Tested and fully operational on **1.21.11**.
* **Loaders:** Works flawlessly on **Paper** and **Spigot** servers.
